bullets: 【180PCS Compressed Towels】Package includes 180pcs disposable compressed towels. Each compressed towel unfolded Size is 7.9in x 8.7in, These compressed face towel are all individually packaged and made of plant fibers. Due to the small size and strong water absorption of compressed coin tissue, there is a risk of suffocation. Children under three years old should not use it alone!

【Skin Friendly & Hypoallergenic】Our compressed towel tablets is soft and hypoallergenic, they won't irritate your skin and they can quickly clean your face, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, legs, etc. They can also be used for babies and pet

【Easy to Carry and Use】These compressed coin tissues is 0.28in x 0.78in and individually packaged, when you go out, you can bring some in your bag, they won't take up too much space. When you need to use wet wipe, just take out a compressed coin tissue and drop some clean water on it. It will quickly expand into a 7.9in x 8.7in wet wipe to clean everything

【Multi-Purpose】Our compressed towels tablets are suitable for many occasions such as facial cleaning, outdoor sport, dust cleaning, wipe eyeglasses, remove makeup etc. As long as you have clean water around you, it can replace wet wipes

【Easy to Use】Our compressed towels are made of high-quality non-woven fabric. They are lightweight, soft, and odorless. After expanding with moisture, they can be reused multiple times. You can wet them with cool or warm water as needed
